text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp has begun. As usual, 
Manhattan Cafe is talking with an unseen 
"presence."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon mentions that regarding 
Cafe's 'friend,' she is less interested in 
its 'true identity' and more in 'where it 
is trying to lead Cafe.'

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With more opportunities to communicate 
during this summer training camp than 
usual, I thought it might be important to 
get to know her better.
